subject: Re: STraTA kickoff - few-shot bootstrapping as a product recipe
body:
Anders,

Staffing: Umar 40% (method owner - self-training loop and the practical-recommendations doc), Rosa 40% (packaging, distributed-training configs), Nikhil 50% (see below).

Compute: 32 A100s on titan-a100 best effort; the T5 NLI generation checkpoints from the release mean we don't retrain the generator, just run inference for the synthetic data.

The one non-obvious scope item: to make the recipe deployable, the self-trained models need to be compressed for customer serving budgets. Nothing reusable exists in-house, so we're scoping and building a distillation training recipe from scratch - Nikhil owns it at 50% for the rest of the window, covering teacher selection, temperature/loss-mix schedules, and a regression-tested config set. Without it we'd be handing customers models they can't afford to serve.

Risk: Umar is also reviewing for two conferences in March; I've protected his STraTA days on the calendar.

Alina
